prompt:
Subject:
Night-lit sofa seat

Main Figure:
A full-body vertical photo of a single woman sitting cross-legged on a sofa in the center of the frame in a warm living room with a view of the city lights at night. The main elements include gray loungewear, a beige sofa, a wooden table in the left foreground, and small lamps.

Person/Expression:
The upper body is facing forward, the head is tilted slightly to the right, looking at the camera with brown eyes, and smiling gently with closed coral lips. Small oval face with a rounded chin, rounded almond-shaped eyes, thin parallel eyebrows, a thin bridge, and a small tip of the nose. Pink cheeks, subtle eye makeup, and smooth skin reflecting warm light. Dark brown chin-length bob with thin bangs, a center-ish parting, and hair ends playing lightly inward and outward.

Clothing/Pose:
A pale gray ribbed short camisole top with thin shoulder straps and a deep V-neck. Matching short lounge pants with a wide elastic waist, a ribbon tie in the front center, and thin ruffles at the hem. Sitting barefoot on the sofa with both legs wide open and ankles crossed, both hands resting between the legs with fingers lightly overlapped.

Background/Light:
A window on the left showing a night view with blue points of light, a warm floor lamp, and small plants. A tall houseplant in the center background, a wooden display shelf on the right, a white vase, plants, and indirect lighting. A small glass lamp on the wooden table in the left foreground. Multiple soft warm light sources wrap the face and torso, casting deep amber shadows on the floor and furniture.

Composition/Camera:
3:4 vertical orientation, full-body portrait captured from a horizontal eye level nearly equal to the seated person, from the top of the head to the crossed toes. The figure occupies a large portion of the upper center, with the spread legs forming a triangle to the sides, and the table partially cropped in the lower left foreground. Focus on the face, with the background softly blurred at a medium depth of field.

Texture/Style:
A warm, photorealistic live-action photograph. High-definition rendering of ribbed fabric, sofa weave, wood, skin, and glass lamps, unified by amber light over gray and beige tones.

Negative:
Do not change the cross-legged posture to sitting in a chair; do not change the short bob to long hair.
